# 1. Load Data

```{r}
# Read tables
table.1 <- read.csv(file.choose(), header=T); table.1$Marker <- "MiBird"
table.2 <- read.csv(file.choose(), header=T); table.2$Marker <- "Teleo2"

# MERGE INPUT DATA
table.compare <- rbind(table.1, table.2) #table.4

# Get unique taxonomic information from Phylum to Genus
unique_taxonomy <- table.compare %>%
  select(Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus)


rank_sym <- sym(taxonomic.rank)

# SQUISH WHITESPACE IN TAXA
table.compare <- table.compare %>%
  mutate(
    !!rank_sym := str_squish(!!rank_sym)
  )

df_rank <- table.compare %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(!!rank_sym),
    !!rank_sym != "dropped"
  )

rank_filtration <- df_rank %>%
  distinct(!!rank_sym, TREATMENT) %>%   # presence only
  mutate(present = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = TREATMENT,
    values_from = present,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# rename dynamic rank column to "taxon"
rank_filtration <- rank_filtration %>%
  rename(taxon = !!rank_sym)

library(ComplexUpset)
filename <- paste0("3upset_", taxonomic.rank, ".pdf")
cairo_pdf(filename = filename, width=7, height=4, family="Arial")
upset(
  rank_filtration,
  intersect = c("Coffee-Column", "Coffee-QuickExtract", "Passive-Column", "Passive-QuickExtract", "Sylphium-Sylphium"),  # the FILTRATION columns
  name = "Filtration Method",
  width_ratio = 0.2
)
dev.off()

rank_filtration$Genus=rank_filtration$taxon
rank_filtration$taxon=NULL
rank_filtration=merge(unique_taxonomy, rank_filtration, by="Genus")
write.csv(rank_filtration, file = "2upsetdata_method.csv", row.names = F)
```


```{r}
ranks <- c("Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus")
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ComplexUpset)
library(rlang)

# Suppose table.compare is already loaded (merged from all markers)
# and FILTRATION column exists (Active / Passive)

# Stack all ranks together
rank_long <- lapply(ranks, function(rank_name) {
  
  rank_sym <- sym(rank_name)
  
  table.compare %>%
    # squish whitespace
    mutate(!!rank_sym := str_squish(!!rank_sym)) %>%
    # filter out NA/dropped
    filter(!is.na(!!rank_sym), !!rank_sym != "dropped") %>%
    # keep only unique combinations of taxon + FILTRATION
    distinct(!!rank_sym, TREATMENT) %>%
    mutate(present = 1) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = TREATMENT,
      values_from = present,
      values_fill = 0
    ) %>%
    rename(taxon = !!rank_sym) %>%
    # add rank column
    mutate(rank = rank_name)
  
}) %>% bind_rows()
# Optional: reorder ranks for plotting
rank_long$rank <- factor(rank_long$rank, levels = ranks)

cairo_pdf(filename = "3upset_method.pdf", width=7, height=4, family="Arial")
upset(
  rank_long,
  intersect = c("Coffee-Column", "Coffee-QuickExtract", "Passive-Column", "Passive-QuickExtract", "Sylphium-Sylphium"),  # the FILTRATION columns
  name = "Filtration Method",
  width_ratio = 0.2,
  base_annotations = list(
    'Intersection size' = intersection_size(
      mapping = aes(fill = rank)  # just map fill, don't specify geom
    )
  )
) 
dev.off()
```


```{r}

# Unique to Active
active <- rank_long %>%
  filter(Active == 1 & Passive == 0) %>%
  arrange(rank, taxon)

# Unique to Passive
passive <- rank_long %>%
  filter(Passive == 1 & Active == 0) %>%
  arrange(rank, taxon)

# Active
unique.active=active %>%
  group_by(rank) %>%
  summarise(taxa = paste(taxon, collapse = ", ")) %>%
  mutate(method="Active")

unique.active.sum=active %>%
  group_by(rank) %>%
  summarise(n_unique = n())

# Passive
unique.passive=passive %>%
  group_by(rank) %>%
  summarise(taxa = paste(taxon, collapse = ", ")) %>%
  mutate(method="Passive")

unique.passive.sum=passive %>%
  group_by(rank) %>%
  summarise(n_unique = n())

unique.taxa.method=rbind(unique.active, unique.passive)
write.csv(unique.taxa.method, file="2unique_method_ranks.csv", row.names = F)
```
